# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r imports}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
    }
    grid.segments(
        c(0, .5),
        c(.5, 0),
        c(1, .5),
        c(.5, 1),
        gp = gpar(lty = 4, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
    )
}
```

## Examples

### Vertical Typesetting

```{r vert, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex("The text is rendered vertically by default.", y = .8, direction = 0)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。")
```

### Horizontal Typesetting

```{r horiz, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The \\texttt{direction = 0} parameter typesets text horizontally.",
    width = unit(3, "in"),
    y = .75, direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", direction = 0)
```

### `ggplot` Labels

```{r ggp}
library(ggplot2)
library(gggrid)
label <- function(data, coords) {
    # TODO: Export this.
    upxdvir:::uplatexGrob(
        "このグラフは、自動車の燃費とエンジン排気量との関係を示しています。",
        x = coords$x, y = coords$y,
        hjust = 1, vjust = 1
    )
}

gg <- ggplot(mtcars) +
    geom_point(aes(x = disp, y = mpg))

gg +
    labs(
        x = "エンジン排気量 (Engine Displacement)",
        y = "燃費 (Miles per gallon)",
        title = "エンジン排気量と燃費の関係",
        subtitle = "Engine Displacement vs Fuel Economy"
    ) +
    theme(
        axis.title.x = element_uplatex(direction = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_uplatex(angle = -0, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_uplatex(direction = 0)
    ) +
    grid_panel(
        label,
        data = data.frame(x = max(mtcars$disp), y = max(mtcars$mpg)),
        aes(x, y)
    )
```

### Other Fonts

```{r fonts, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex("これはIPAフォントです。",
    x = .1,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipa")
)
grid.uplatex("これはIPAexフォントです。",
    x = .3,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipaex")
)
grid.uplatex("これはHaranoAjiフォントです。",
    x = .5,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "haranoaji")
)
grid.uplatex("これはSourceHanフォントです。",
    x = .7,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "sourcehan")
)
grid.uplatex("デフォルトのフォント。", x = .9)
```

## Regression Checks

```{r reg, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("LuaTeX", engine = "LuaTeX", y = .7)
grid.latex("XeTeX", engine = "XeTeX", y = .3)
```
